_all.reason: Claude web and desktop custom connectors need an HTTPS MCP URL reachable by Claude. Release 1 ships no general public gateway (only the OpenAI-only secure tunnel). An agent cannot sign in to the owner's Claude account or publish an endpoint.

Hosted ChatGPT needs the owner's OpenAI tunnel ID and runtime API key and ChatGPT developer mode. Those credentials must not be handled by an agent. An earlier real-ChatGPT run of search, fetch and context_build over the tunnel (MP-7MCP-04 baseline) was on an older build and is not claimed for this SHA.

Hosted Gemini needs the owner's account (Connect to an MCP server or Developer Mode) and an HTTPS endpoint reachable by Gemini. The Gemini app custom-app feature is reported to require an eligible personal account; if the owner's account is not eligible the result is PROVIDER_BLOCKED, to be recorded on the card.
